track: Phase 1 LoRA on the frozen POC 2 corpus
limitations: These are demo prompts, not held-out evidence or promotion gates.
Learned source labels are lineage, not real citations; only search returns retrieved citations.
Report measured outcomes in all three modes; do not script a search failure or a learning win.

scenarios.title: A company fact
scenarios.question: Which person owns the Kestrel service?
scenarios.purpose: Compare without learning, with LoRA and search on an existing fact.

scenarios.title: Combine two existing facts
scenarios.question: Give the Vela retention period together with the Cirrus priority support response target.
scenarios.purpose: Test two-fact composition. POC 2 scored poorly here; success is not assumed.

scenarios.title: The company guidance changes
steps: Edit sable.txt in Box: 73 GB becomes 96 GB. Remove the old Quartz location guidance (or replace quartz.txt with the retirement notice).
Sync, inspect the changed value and retirement, and approve both in Review.
Disclose that version 2 was trained beforehand, then switch to that pre-trained version. The live edit demonstrates sync and review, not live retraining.
Ask for the Sable daily limit and current Quartz location. Show model version and snapshot identifiers.
scenarios.expected: 96 GB; decline to give a current Quartz location. Report stale answers as failures.

scenarios.title: E42 environmental check before replacement
scenarios.question: A Halvard pump reports E42. Inlet pressure is 3.1 bar and no retest has happened. Is a pump exchange the right next action?
scenarios.expected: Measure/check inlet pressure first, restore it to at least 4 bar, and retest. Do not replace now; replacement needs adequate pressure and persistent E42 after retesting.
scenarios.purpose: Contrast correct procedure use with premature replacement; there is no separate fan-failure fact.

scenarios.title: Apply a supplied unfamiliar rule
scenarios.question: Use this new rule: for B64 filter faults, measure feed conductivity first; below 8 mS/cm, correct the feed and retest without changing the filter. At least 8 mS/cm with B64 still present after retesting requires filter replacement. A test rig shows B64 at 6.2 mS/cm before any retest. What next?
scenarios.expected: Correct feed conductivity and retest; do not replace the filter now.
scenarios.purpose: The held-out rule is supplied in the question. This tests instruction following and environmental-first habit, not knowledge of an unseen company rule. Keep this prompt outside training; it is not a new corpus item.

scenarios.title: Decline an unsupported request
scenarios.question: What annual subscription fee does the Nacre gateway charge?
scenarios.expected: I do not know; the approved documents do not specify a subscription fee.
scenarios.purpose: Check abstention; show actual dev gate results, including rejected candidates. Do not claim training guarantees abstention.
